description_en: Searches for media assets by face image (coarse search). Accepts a face image as input and returns information about media assets that contain the person
description_zh: 人脸图片搜媒资接口（粗搜），输入一张人脸图片，搜索该人物所在媒资的相关信息
name: SearchMediaByFace

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face image
parameters.name: person_image_url

parameters.help_en: The token used to identify paginated results under the same search condition. Use this parameter together with the FaceSearchToken parameter in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612891.html
parameters.help_zh: 通过该参数判断是同一个搜索条件下的分页返回，与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612891.html里的FaceSearchToken配合使用
parameters.name: face_search_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en:
The media asset type. Valid values:
image: image
video: video
parameters.help_zh:
媒资类型。取值：
image：图片
video：视频
parameters.name: media_type
custom_filters

parameters.help_en:
The creation time, in millisecond-precision timestamp. gte specifies greater than or equal to, and lte specifies less than or equal to.
Range, such as {"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}
parameters.help_zh:
创建时间，毫秒时间戳。gte大于等于，lte小于等于。
范围，如{"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}
parameters.name: utc_create

MediaInfoList.description_en: The list of media assets that match the search criteria

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values: true: The operation was successful. false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh: 操作是否成功。取值：true：成功。false：失败

Total.description_en: The total number of media assets that match the search criteria
Total.description_zh: 满足搜索条件的媒资信息总条数
